pl-l3d28c2-d1e115.summary: Raises the question whether love of angels pertains to the commandment of love of neighbor. That no man is excepted is shown by the parable of the man left half-dead, where the Lord calls neighbor the one who showed mercy and adds 'go and do likewise'; the sentence continues into the next chapter.
claims: No man is excepted from the commandment of love of neighbor.

pl-l3d28c2.summary: Raises the question whether love of angels belongs to the commandment to love the neighbor, recalling that in the parable of the half-dead man the Lord excepted no man from the neighbor and said 'go and do likewise'. The sentence continues in the next chapter.
claims: The commandment of love of neighbor excepts no man.
